description:
List the companies in an industry, using the SEC's Standard Industrial Classification (SIC).

Pass a SIC code (3-4 digits, e.g. "6200" for securities brokers and exchanges, "3571" for electronic
computers, "7372" for prepackaged software) to get its companies: CIK, name, ticker, state of
incorporation and fiscal year end, 100 per page, companies with a ticker first. Get a company's own
code from get_company or search_companies (sic).

If you do not know the code, pass a word from the industry name instead ("software", "pharmaceutical",
"bank", "oil") and you get the matching SIC codes with how many companies each has; then call again
with the code you want. list_sic_codes shows the whole classification.

SIC is the SEC's classification of the filer, assigned when it registers. It is not GICS or NAICS,
individuals and most funds have none, and some codes are broad (e.g. 6770 "blank checks").

Args:
    industry: a SIC code like "6200", or a word to look up codes by ("software")
    query: with a code: only companies whose name or ticker contains this
    page: with a code: page number, 100 companies per page (default 1)
    listed_only: with a code: only companies that have an exchange ticker (default True). Set False
        to include the many dormant, delisted and asset-backed entities that carry the same code.
name: list_companies_by_sic
title: List Companies by Industry (SIC)
